RESOLVER FIXTURE -- not sent to a model.

This scenario exists to test one thing: that the app enforces the
one-custom-audience limit itself, rather than trusting the drafting prompt
to. Its companion .draft.json deliberately returns THREE non-RFP-selectable
segments plus one selectable one, which is more than a campaign can book.

The prompt asks the model for at most one, and that guidance is worth
keeping -- it makes the first pass better and means the surviving segment
is the one the model ranked highest. But a prompt instruction is a
probability, not a guarantee: these same notes produced one custom segment
on one live run and two on the next, which is what moved the limit into
Python.

Tier 2 never reads this file -- it has its own explicit scenario list, so
this fixture costs no API calls.

Notes, for the record:
Regional auto dealer group, four rooftops. Wants in-market shoppers across
several body styles. Direct, no agency. $40,000 for the flight, streaming
TV only. Running March through May.
